vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: maccabi-pharm-search
Version: 2.0.0

The skill is designed to search for medications and check stock at Maccabi pharmacies in Israel. The `pharmacy-search.js` script correctly sanitizes user input by using `encodeURIComponent` for URL parameters and passing other arguments as JSON body parameters, preventing shell or URL injection vulnerabilities. All network requests are directed to the legitimate Maccabi Healthcare Services API (`https://serguide.maccabi4u.co.il`). The `SKILL.md` and `README.md` files contain only instructions relevant to the skill's stated purpose and do not exhibit any prompt injection attempts against the agent or other malicious behaviors. No evidence of data exfiltration, persistence, or obfuscation was found.
